signatureNote: Original procedural geometry inspired by characteristic part TYPES from the study materials; no model, mesh, texture or silhouette is imported, traced or extracted. Every part is drawn from parametric primitives in tools/src/20_render.js. Players may mix any parts freely. Body plans include biped, reverse-joint, tetrapod/spider four-leg, legless hover disc, tracked siege hull and legless flight frame.
